details: DELETE /api/auth/users/{username} archives to deleted_users before deletion
Archive record includes: deleted_at, deleted_by, deletion_reason, original_tenant_id, original_role
Message confirms 'Record archived for audit'
DELETE /api/super-admin/admins/{username} archives admin to deleted_users
Archives all employees of admin to deleted_users with deletion_reason='parent_admin_deleted'
Archives tenant data to archived_tenant_data collection
POST /api/public/signup checks deleted_users for email
Sets returning_user=true if email was previously deleted
Stores previous_tenant_id for audit trail
GET /api/super-admin/deleted-users requires super_admin role
Returns deleted_users array with audit fields
Returns archived_tenants array with data summaries
Returns total_deleted_users and total_archived_tenants counts
Employee inherits tenant_id from parent admin
Max employees enforced per plan (Starter=2, Professional=5, Enterprise=20)
Email format validation (regex: ^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$)
Duplicate email blocked across users and prospects collections
Shows Pending Requests, Near Expiry (30d), Expired, Total Requests stats
Lists near-expiry admins with Extend button
Lists renewal requests with Approve/Reject buttons
